annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Doing nothing costs five people; acting costs nothing.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd bet the workers feel pretty rattled

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: watching lets the train hit five people when a safe path exists
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Somebody at the station might think I'm overstepping

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five lives against zero harm isn't much of a trade-off
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect the workers assume the line is quiet right now.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: every second I stall brings the train closer
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: A railway manager might be annoyed I used the lever.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Waiting means five workers get hit; acting means... nothing bad happens
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My guess is the staff would agree with the call

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: nobody endangered by the switch, five workers spared
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine they'd be stunned later
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: stunned later to hear how close it came

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Some people believe staying hands-off keeps their conscience clean.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: it's the one that lets five people get hit
annotations.pda_responsibility: not acting is still a choice

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: only one of those leaves everyone standing
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd expect my partner... to say 'of course you did.'

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: won't bet five people on it
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: one of them would be irritated that a stranger touched the controls

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: action against inaction, and inaction loses badly
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: workers might well be absorbed in their tasks
